Beginner.learningGoal: Use nullable types with safe calls, the Elvis operator and let instead of null checks and !!.
gotchas: !! throws NullPointerException; a test can only assert on the safe path
?.let { } skips the block for null, which is easy to confuse with an empty value
String?.isNullOrBlank() vs isNullOrEmpty() treat whitespace differently
shapeHints: resolving a user's display name from nullable first, last and nickname
reading a nested optional address city
parsing a nullable string to an Int with a default

Intermediate.learningGoal: Combine nullable chains with smart casts, safe casts and collection helpers such as mapNotNull and firstOrNull.
gotchas: Smart cast fails on mutable var properties and open or custom-getter properties
as? returns null while as throws ClassCastException
map { it?.x } keeps nulls while mapNotNull drops them
goodSolutionShows: mapNotNull / filterNotNull instead of filter plus !!
Local val to enable smart cast
shapeHints: parsing a list of strings and reporting how many failed
looking up a config through several fallback sources
extracting typed values from a Map<String, Any?>

Advanced.learningGoal: Design APIs that make absence explicit and handle platform-type and generic nullability edge cases.
gotchas: A generic T has an implicit nullable upper bound (T : Any? ); use T : Any to forbid null
Map.get returns V? even if V is nullable, making null ambiguous
requireNotNull and checkNotNull throw different exception types
goodSolutionShows: T : Any bound where null must be rejected
contains/containsKey to distinguish absent from null value
shapeHints: a typed cache that distinguishes missing from cached null
a generic Result-like holder rejecting null
a safe lookup helper over nested maps
